mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits dopamine beta-hydroxylase, reducing the conversion of dopamine to norepinephrine, which can potentiate dopaminergic effects and lead to psychiatric symptoms, hypertension, and reduced efficacy of levodopa therapy.
action: Avoid concomitant use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for psychiatric manifestations, hypertensive episodes, and reduced antiparkinsonian efficacy; consider alternative alcohol deterrent therapy.
